title.zh: Tools for One / 一个人的数字工具

short.zh: 从日常材料、记忆和个人数据出发，用 AI 与 creative coding 制作一个真正属于自己的数字系统。
short.en: Build a personal digital system from everyday materials, memories, and personal data using AI and creative coding.

premise.zh: 重点不是学习某一个软件，而是把生活中的材料变成一个可以继续使用、修改和迭代的个人工具。
premise.en: The goal is not to learn one application, but to turn materials from everyday life into a personal tool that can keep being used, modified, and iterated.
